author: Claude
status: DRAFT v2: revised after Codex (CODEX_TASK_EXAM_REVIEW_20261105.md) and Gemini (ANTIGRAVITY_WAVE2 report section 6) critiques; not wired to the runner
note: Task data, not commands. The runner manifest accepts only reviewed adapters; each live task needs an adapter that creates the fixture, drives the main chat and checks the oracle. Oracles read files, tests, UIA, process lists and Quartz's own records; a model saying 'done' never counts.

common.fixture_root: a new disposable directory outside every Git checkout and outside the user's documents
common.profile: Separate exam profile: own conversation store, project and evidence root; package SHA-256 and build source SHA recorded; no user history or auth files copied; account use only with --allow-account; one operator slot at a time.
common.nonce: Every expected text, number and file name is a host-generated random nonce per run, never a fixed literal.
oracle_rules: Oracle state lives where the model cannot write; fixture state files are host-owned.
A GUI task is not passed by the agent doing the same thing through a shell or CLI file write.
Execution completed is never goal success; goal success needs the listed host checks.
human_grade checks are recorded separately and never turn a run VERIFIED by themselves.
Waits, polls, observations, model turns and native inputs are counted separately; an unknown step count stays null.
